Modern AP hardware types include dual or triple band radios.
A limited subset of band combinations are supported.
Operating mode defines the supported band combinations per radio.    
Access Points with fixed band radios use GENERIC operating mode.  
SERVICE_2_5_6:   wifi0-2.4Ghz, wifi1-5Ghz, wifi2-6Ghz
SENSOR_SERVICE_5_6: wifi0-Tri-band sensor, wifi1-5Ghz, wifi2-6Ghz
SERVICE_5L_5H_6: wifi0-5G Low, wifi1-5G High, wifi2-6Ghz
SENSOR_SERVICE_5_2: wifi0-Tri-band sensor, wifi1-5GHz, wifi2-2.4Ghz
